problem_statement: Build a brand-new /snippets page from scratch on the ixartz Astro-boilerplate dev-blog site (Astro 4 + React islands + Tailwind). The route /snippets does not exist yet (baseline is empty/404). Construct a full 'Code Snippets' library page that reuses the site's shared Base template chrome (Navbar with Blogs/GitHub/Twitter + Footer copyright) and the dark slate theme so it is visually consistent with the existing home/blog pages (cross-page consistency). The page shows a hero, a 'Browse by language' section with a client-side language filter (All / TypeScript / CSS / Shell) implemented as buttons, a live result-count heading, and a responsive grid of snippet cards that filters according to the selected language. Must be mobile-clean (no horizontal overflow at 390px).
required_content: Reuse the shared Base template (Navbar with Blogs/GitHub/Twitter + Footer copyright) so nav/footer match every sibling page (cross-page consistency)
Hero: h1 'Code Snippets' + a lede paragraph describing the copy-paste snippet library
'Browse by language' section with a language filter: four buttons labelled All, TypeScript, CSS, Shell (unique data-lang attribute)
A live result-count heading (h3) reading 'Showing all 6 snippets.' by default

Data-driven grid of snippet cards, each with an h3 title + a one-line description and a language tag (Debounce a function, Typed fetch wrapper, Deep clone, Center a div with grid, Truncate text, Find the largest files)
Client-side interaction: clicking TypeScript hides non-TypeScript cards and updates the count to 'Showing 3 TypeScript snippets.'
Inline static snippet data (no network fetch)
Responsive: snippet grid collapses to single column on mobile with zero horizontal overflow
design_constraints: Reuse src/templates/Base.astro (shared Navbar + Footer chrome + <html> shell)
Reuse the astro-boilerplate-components Section + GradientText components
Use the site's dark slate Tailwind theme (bg-slate-900/bg-slate-800 surfaces, text-gray-100/300, cyan-400/500 accents, max-w-screen-lg container)
No external fonts or network fetches
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 缺 /snippets(仅空 <html><body></body>,无 layout, #18k SSG 静态服务器否则回退 index.html); reference 完整实现 + 工作 language filter; bad 与 reference 逐字节相同,只把 filter 脚本的 querySelectorAll('button[data-lang]') 改成 'button[data-filter]' → 监听器不挂载,点击语言按钮无反应 → 只失 interaction gate,其余 18/19 全过。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同。#18ae: 三份都从 astro.config 删除 sitemap()。跨页一致性(#18ag)编码为 nav <a>'Blogs' + footer <a>'CreativeDesignsGuru' 的 dom_assertions,同时绑 desktop_snippets 与 sibling desktop_home 两个 state(V5 只重放 dom/interaction/overflow/regression,故一致性必须是真 dom_assertion 而非独立 gate 字符串)。
